NDT ERP software for inspection companies in Pearland

Pearland NDT companies need an ERP that runs two businesses at once: shop inspection for the manufacturers and fabricators in and around the city, and field crews sent out to the plants along the Houston Ship Channel, Texas City, Chocolate Bayou and Freeport. The Atlantis ERP solution handles both from one system, with technician certification tracking, calibration management, crew dispatch, 17 method-specific NDT report types, procedure control, quoting and invoicing all tied to the same job record.

Pearland sits on State Highway 288 just south of Beltway 8, which puts a contractor based here within reach of most of the Gulf Coast's refining and petrochemical capacity while keeping lower overheads than an inner-Houston yard. That location is an advantage, but it also means your crews are spread thin across many clients, each with its own pre-qualification rules, report formats and billing expectations. Holding that together on spreadsheets, a shared calendar and an accounting package that never sees the job is how certificates lapse unnoticed, instruments go out of calibration mid-job and standby time never gets billed.

This section explains how the Atlantis ERP runs that work, what is built in, and what gets configured during implementation. To see it with your own methods and clients, ask for a Pearland demo. Affordable, accessible, fully customizable, quote on request.

Shop inspection for Pearland's manufacturing base

Pearland's Lower Kirby District, about 1,200 acres along Beltway 8 and SH 288, has pulled in industrial and energy employers, including Endress+Hauser's Gulf Coast regional campus, a Dover Energy manufacturing and operations facility and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries' compressor business, alongside a long list of smaller machine shops, oilfield tool makers and fabricators around the city. Manufacturers like these generate steady in-shop and source inspection work: PT and MT on machined and welded parts, UT on forgings and welds, PMI and hardness on alloy components, and visual and dimensional checks, often witnessed by a client or third-party inspector.

Shop work has a different shape from field work. Jobs are short and frequent, the same customer sends parts week after week, each customer wants its own report format, and a third-party inspector may need to sign the report before it ships. The Atlantis ERP handles this with project records that carry job type, site, client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria, and reports that include a field for the third-party or authorized inspector's name and signature. Excel report templates can be mapped field by field to a customer's own spreadsheet, so repeat customers get their format without anyone retyping.

  • PMI and hardness reports for alloy verification on valves, fittings and machined parts.
  • PT and MT reports with method, developer, technique and particle type recorded.
  • UT and UT thickness reports with probe calibration tables and readings by direction.
  • Ferrite reports for duplex and austenitic stainless welds.

Field crews for the Ship Channel, Texas City and Brazoria County plants

The other half of a typical Pearland contractor's work is field inspection at refineries and chemical plants within driving distance. That work comes in spikes, especially during spring and fall turnaround seasons, and it is disrupted every summer and fall by the Gulf hurricane season, when plants shut down, reschedule and restart at short notice.

Team Assignments is where that is managed. Each job moves from planned to dispatched to in field to submitted to closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. The technician availability calendar records assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable entries and blocks overlaps, and double-booking of technicians or equipment serial numbers is blocked. For each person you see status, current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date, in calendar, kanban or list view. When a storm pushes a turnaround back by a week, you move the assignments and immediately see who has been freed up for shop work and who is now double-committed.

Timesheets record work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client, equipment serial and approval. The standby line matters a lot on the Gulf Coast, where crews routinely wait on permits, gas tests and unit releases. Standby recorded on the day, with a billable flag, is standby you can defend on the invoice.

Technician certification tracking software for Houston-area competition

The Houston market competes hard for qualified technicians, and people move between companies often. Every new hire brings certificates that need checking, and every departure takes employer-based certification with them. Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP records each certificate's scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level from trainee to Level III, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam result and attachments, with status calculated automatically as active, expiring soon (within 90 days), expired or revoked.

Vision tests record near vision (Jaeger J1 or J2), far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry. Examination sheets hold general, specific and practical scores against a passing score that defaults to 70 percent, and certificate templates per scheme store validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours. When you certify a new hire under your own written practice, the system records the evidence that they met it.

The employee NDT profile shows technician flag, highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires, configurable email alerts go to the people you choose, and timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid. A plant auditor asking whether everyone on a given job was current gets an answer from the job record in minutes.

Calibration management software for a busy shop and field fleet

Asset Management tracks every instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number with equipment type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories, lifecycle state (new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired, disposed), calibration frequency and status. Rental rates can be recorded, which suits Pearland companies that rent flaw detectors, PMI analysers or PAUT sets to other contractors when their own crews are quiet.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result and next due date. The calibration certificate register stores the lab accreditation number, valid, expiring or expired status, the PDF and expiry alerts. Dispatch warns when an instrument assigned to a job is out of calibration, and reservations stop the shop and the field crew claiming the same serial for the same day.

Equipment moves through an issue and return workflow with supervisor and manager approval and condition recorded at both ends. The maintenance log covers preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement entries with condition before and after. Consumables such as penetrant, developer, cleaner, magnetic particle media, couplant and PPE carry reorder levels and a low-stock flag. Purchase records classify vendors as OEM, dealer or calibration lab, hold an accredited-lab flag with accreditation number and expiry, and link order lines to the specific equipment serial, so you can see what each instrument actually costs you to keep in service.

NDT reporting software with method-specific data

Reporting is built into the Atlantis ERP and shares its engine with the standalone Digital Twin Reporting Software. It covers 17 report types, each with its own numbering sequence: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography.

Each method has its own fields: UT probe calibration tables, RT source, technique, IQI type and placement, MT technique and particle type, PT method and developer, PAUT focal laws, MFL scan mode and item lines, UT thickness readings by direction, and weld and job lines with defect type and orientation. The overall result is acceptable, not acceptable, or acceptable with remarks. Each report references work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard.

Reports move from draft to in progress to review to approved to sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures. Company templates are versioned in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML with your logo, header and footer. The offline field app installs as a web app and works without signal inside vessels and congested units, storing drafts and photos locally, capturing an on-screen signature and syncing later. For Pearland contractors who also do marine work at Galveston Bay terminals and shipyards, a marine mode adds a vessel cover page and merges the classification-society certificate (DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, BV, RINA, IRS, ClassNK), the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate into the PDF.

Procedure control that holds up with many customers

A company serving dozens of manufacturers and plant owners ends up with many procedures and many revisions, and each customer wants to know which one you used. The Procedures app keeps a register with document number, revision, method (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET, TOFD, PAUT, LT, AE, hardness, PMI, CR, DR and more), scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria, and body text or an uploaded file.

Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected and archived states, recorded reasons for rejection, dated prepared, reviewed and approved-by fields, locked approved revisions and a snapshot of every revision. Approvers get email notifications and reminders. An AI-assisted first draft can speed up a new procedure and falls back to a built-in template; a Level III still reviews and approves it. When a customer's quality team audits you, you show them the revision in force on the day, who approved it and every report that referenced it.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for high-volume work

Quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products flagged with method and category, a global discount and a branded PDF. Customers can accept and sign online and the quote converts to a sales order, which suits shop customers who send repeat work under a standing scope. Invoices carry NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables. Lines record cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours.

Billable timesheet hours and their rate multipliers feed billing, so overtime and premium time on turnarounds reach the invoice without re-keying. Field expenses and per diems logged in Expenses can be re-billed to the job. Taxes, payments and reminders are configured for Texas during implementation. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over a 12-month view, and cost centres let you compare shop margin with field margin. Request a quote scoped to your team.

Winning more work: CRM and marketing for a Houston-area NDT company

Pearland contractors compete with dozens of Houston-area NDT companies for the same plant and fabrication work. The CRM in the Atlantis ERP records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, and gives each lead an NDT score from 0 to 100 (hot, warm, nurture, cold). Leads import from CSV, and you can enrol a lead in a drip email sequence with an AI-personalised email preview.

Business cards from Houston trade shows and client meetings can be photographed; name, company, title, email, phones and website are extracted, and one click creates a CRM lead or adds the contact to a mailing list. AI marketing tools draft newsletters, promotions, nurture and announcement emails using an AI model that can run on your own server, with drip sequences by service line, pause, resume, unsubscribe and scheduling. Your website's enquiry forms feed straight into the CRM.

Integrations and the rest of the Atlantis stack

The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, with each integration scoped per implementation. A field-device API lists jobs and equipment assigned to each technician and handles report submission and sync. Dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue for return. Company certifications such as your ISO registration carry their own alert days.

Plant owners who want inspection data in 3D can use Atlantis Digital Twins for indication mapping and thickness and remaining-life trends. Trainees can practise on the Practical NDT 3D simulator, and the eLearning app hosts Level I, II and III content with quizzes and completion certificates. Every module is listed on the ERP apps page, including quotations, invoicing and CRM.

How a Pearland implementation runs

We usually begin with technicians, certificates and the instrument register, because shop customers and plant auditors check those first. Dispatch goes live next, with the shop and each regular field site set up so the availability calendar covers both. Report templates, including customer-specific Excel formats, follow, along with the offline app, procedures, quotations and invoicing. Integrations with accounting or customer systems are scoped and built last. Atlantis NDT is Houston-rooted, and founder Anoop Rayavarapu, an ASNT NDT Level III, reviews the NDT-specific configuration. Book a scoping call.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for small NDT companies in Pearland?

The best fit for a small Pearland company is one affordable, customizable system that runs shop and field work together: certifications, calibration, dispatch, reports and invoicing. The Atlantis ERP solution does that, with a quote on request.

Can we produce reports in each customer's own format?

Yes. Versioned company templates come in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML, and Excel templates fill automatically by mapping fields to cells.

Does the report support a third-party inspector's signature?

Yes. Reports carry inspector, reviewer and approver signatures plus a third-party or authorized inspector's name and signature.

Can we track instruments we rent out?

Yes. Rented out is a lifecycle state, rental rates can be recorded, and issue, return and movement records show where each serial is.

How do we handle hurricane-season schedule changes?

Move the affected assignments in the calendar or kanban view; the availability calendar and double-booking checks immediately show who is free and who is overcommitted.

Can it work with QuickBooks?

Yes. The open REST API integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped during implementation.

Does Atlantis train technicians?

Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, and the ERP records any other certificates your technicians already hold.
